about.title: About Splatoon 3 AI Coach
about.p1: This website is my personal project, and I am a big fan of Splatoon 3. I have been playing since the first Splatoon, and no game has pulled me in the way Splatoon 3 has. Building this AI coach is as much fun for me as playing the game. I have reached S+ rank, but my highest X Power is about 1800, and I want to get better. I hope this tool helps me improve my own play, and I would be glad if the people who use it find it useful.
about.p2: What I care about while building it is this: first, detect the evidence in the images accurately and state it as fact, without adding my own interpretation. From the evidence I collect, I build scenarios, understand those scenarios as facts, turn them into coaching advice, and finally have the AI put that advice into words that are easy to follow.
about.source_before: The source code is public on
about.source_after: , so please use it freely. If you have comments or impressions, please send them through the contact form. I wish you good battles!
